text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Mejiro
Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! Just look at all these wonderful
plushies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So much detail has been put into their
outfits!
They're so adorable!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not especially skilled when it
comes to
claw machines...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When I was younger, Dober and I
operated one
at a Japanese-style inn we
were visiting on a
Mejiro family
excursion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But the prizes seemed to escape capture

whenever I was at the controls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I doubt they were literally
"escaping" her, I
can definitely picture
the scene. With that in
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You'd be willing to do that? Then yes,
please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
